steps.what: Review difficult-case information and prepare nursing observations and diagnostic or treatment questions
outputs: verified case contribution and unresolved questions

steps.what: Participate in treatment team conferences on difficult-case diagnosis or treatment and clarify follow-up
inputs: verified case contribution and unresolved questions
outputs: shared case understanding and recorded follow-up responsibilities

tasks.design: Retain active treatment conference participation using existing case records {OTHER}. No meeting agent or generated clinical consensus replaces the nurse's contribution and clarification.
tasks.previous_blocker: Difficult cases require real discussion of uncertain evidence and treatment views.
tasks.enabler_now: Current records and conference channels support the task without a new model.
tasks.still_hard: Communicate uncertainty and establish shared understanding without hiding disagreement.
tasks.human_edge: Bring direct nursing observations and ask questions that change the team's understanding.

reach.task: Clarify unresolved case questions and follow-up ownership
reach.learn: Which nursing concerns require explicit discussion

evidence.claim: Documentation tools do not establish reduced active difficult-case conference participation time.

assumptions: Care staff produce existing case records and the chair supplies conference purpose; preparation and question capture remain in s1.
All discussion and follow-up capture remain in s2; no free structured consensus feed is assumed.
This conference task overlaps broader interdisciplinary collaboration and complex-case consultation; baselines are not additive.
Other participants' time is unchanged outside focal savings; no new upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Conference format and current follow-up recording
research_questions: Which difficult-case questions repeatedly leave conferences without clear follow-up?

already_counted.description: Preparation and conference contribution remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new conference service or maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and zero incremental work give zero saving. No clinical discussion time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify diagnostic or laboratory test identity, timing, quality and relevant patient context
outputs: verified test evidence and unresolved quality questions

steps.what: Interpret diagnostic or laboratory tests within scope and communicate conclusions and unresolved concerns
inputs: verified test evidence and unresolved quality questions
outputs: documented test interpretation or specialist referral question

tasks.design: Retain interpretation of tests such as EKGs or renal-function results with appropriately qualified staff using existing clinical records {OTHER}. No general model interprets a result or substitutes a numerical flag for contextual assessment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Results must be related to test quality, timing and patient circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing test records support the work; specialised mammography evidence does not establish general test interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish a meaningful change from artefact or an incomplete result.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise limits and obtain the right specialist review.

reach.task: Clarify interpretation beyond the nurse's competence or authority
reach.learn: Which source context is required for specialist review

evidence.claim: Transpara's specialised mammography capability does not establish automation of EKG or renal test interpretation for this role.

assumptions: Diagnostic and laboratory staff produce authorised results in existing testing processes; test acquisition is outside this interpretation baseline.
The nurse verifies identity, timing and quality in s1 and captures interpretation in s2; all source checks and reasoning remain.
Professional competence and authority are verified; unsupported interpretation is referred rather than automated.
No free reconciled test series, new calculator or model is introduced; no incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Actual test interpretation scope and specialist access
research_questions: Which test context gaps most often require clarification before interpretation?

already_counted.description: Source verification and interpretation remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new diagnostic system or maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and no incremental work give zero saving. Existing numeric results do not remove contextual interpretation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop research-based mental health practice protocols

steps.what: Review and evaluate published research and capture supported mental health protocol recommendations and limitations
outputs: appraised evidence packet with supported recommendations and limitations

steps.what: Draft mental health practice protocol wording from appraised recommendations and source passages
inputs: appraised evidence packet with supported recommendations and limitations

loop.purpose: Express already appraised recommendations in consistent protocol wording without deciding evidence strength.
loop.input: Nurse-appraised evidence packet with source passages, limitations and approved structure.
loop.output: Draft protocol sections with passage links and explicit unresolved questions.
loop.check: Nurse compares every instruction, population, exclusion, condition and recommendation strength with the appraised packet and checks missing safeguards and unsupported additions.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass maximum; unsupported clinical meaning or contradictory sources return the section to manual drafting.
loop.why_not_simpler: Document structure and version comparison are deterministic; translating appraised source recommendations into readable protocol wording needs bounded language interpretation.

steps.what: Verify protocol meaning, correct omissions and submit the reviewed version for governance approval
inputs: appraised evidence packet with supported recommendations and limitations
outputs: reviewed protocol proposal with unresolved questions

steps.what: Review the final practice protocol and authorise only the exact approved version for use
inputs: reviewed protocol proposal with unresolved questions
outputs: authorised practice protocol or returned revision request

tasks.design: Use fixed protocol structure and bounded wording assistance in an approved document environment {DOCS}. The nurse retains literature evaluation and semantic verification, and clinical governance retains final authorisation before the protocol can be used.
tasks.previous_blocker: Protocol prose is repeatedly composed after the difficult evidence appraisal has been completed.
tasks.enabler_now: A language model can propose wording from a supplied appraised packet, with local validation; no clinical scribe result establishes savings for this task.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve conflicting findings and preserve conditions, exclusions and uncertainty in usable instructions.
tasks.human_edge: Judge evidence and recognise when wording changes the clinical recommendation.
tasks.altitude: Less wording preparation with retained evidence and governance responsibility.

reach.task: Evaluate protocol suitability and authorise the final version
reach.learn: Which evidence or implementation gaps prevent release

evidence.claim: Source-grounded mental health protocol wording assistance is an E1 proposal; the digest's scribe cases do not measure protocol development.

assumptions: Publishers produce existing research and governance supplies scope and structure; the nurse locates, appraises and captures recommendations and limitations in s1, with full time retained.
No free structured evidence table or automatic research appraisal is assumed.
Use native document structure and comparison first; bounded generation only changes prose preparation, never clinical evidence selection.
No patient-identifiable data are needed in the drafting packet. Missing support returns the section to manual work.
Governance review stays at full time; revisions invalidate both relevant approvals and require renewed review.
unknowns: Local protocol governance and current drafting share
research_questions: Does bounded drafting reduce total nurse time after evidence capture, omission checking, correction and audit?

already_counted.description: Research appraisal and final nurse verification remain fully counted, in original step shares.
Draft review remains counted, in original step shares.
Unchanged governance review remains other-role work, in original step shares.

incremental.description: Nurse checks source-fidelity samples and drafting updates.
Documentation owner maintains structures and validates model changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact corrected protocol proposal including source links, recommendations, exclusions and unresolved questions; any edit or source change voids approval.
Exact final reviewed protocol version and effective scope; unresolved material questions block release, and any wording or source change requires fresh nurse and governance review.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 focal B=90, R=35+15+25=75; gross 16.67 percent less 3 focal audit hours per 100 focal baseline gives net 13.67. High 13 is below that ceiling; low covers manual drafting or heavy checking. Unchanged other-role governance share 10 is excluded from focal savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop, implement or evaluate mental health programs

steps.what: Assess outreach, community mental health or crisis response program needs with relevant stakeholders
outputs: verified program needs and practical constraints

steps.what: Develop or implement mental health program actions and evaluate them with partners and participants
inputs: verified program needs and practical constraints
outputs: program actions and documented evaluation findings

tasks.design: Retain needs assessment, program work and evaluation with the nurse and partners using existing documents {DOCS} and program records {OTHER}. No automatic outreach targeting, crisis-response decision or invented clean outcome feed is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful programs depend on local needs, resources and trusted coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing program records support this work without a new model.
tasks.still_hard: Understand participation barriers and distinguish useful effects from incomplete feedback.
tasks.human_edge: Build trust and judge what is practical and appropriate for the community.
tasks.altitude: Ground program action and evaluation in local experience.

reach.task: Clarify participation barriers and implementation responsibilities
reach.learn: Which local constraints affect program usefulness

evidence.claim: Documentation tools do not establish reduced community program development or implementation time.

assumptions: Existing program staff produce current records; stakeholder needs are elicited and verified during retained s1 time.
The nurse and partners capture actions and evaluation findings during s2; all feedback gathering and interpretation remain counted.
No free structured outcome, participant eligibility or crisis status feed is assumed.
This broad program task excludes separately governed protocol drafting; partner work remains unchanged outside focal savings and no new upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Program scope, authority and existing evaluation approach
research_questions: Which participation and resource barriers recur in program implementation?

already_counted.description: Needs assessment, program action and evaluation remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new outreach or evaluation system maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and no incremental work give zero saving. No unsupported outcome-reporting or partner coordination reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain clinical interpretation and program judgement while reducing validated protocol prose preparation.
reach: Clarify difficult cases with treatment teams
Work with community partners on practical program barriers
role.ambitious_version: A psychiatric nurse who uses careful drafting support and keeps clinical and program responsibility with qualified people.
